categories.heading: Choose the Category That Fits Your Expectations & Budget
categories.description: A comprehensive overview of approved Hajj and Umrah program categories to simplify comparison and make informed decisions.

umrah_economy.title: Economy Umrah
umrah_economy.desc: Programs focused on essential value, providing verified accommodations and scheduled shuttle transportation to and from the Holy Mosque.
umrah_economy.feat_1: Classified hotels with dedicated regular shuttle service
umrah_economy.feat_2: Flexible travel itineraries tailored for cost efficiency
umrah_economy.feat_3: Organized pilgrim assistance with dependable service levels

umrah_premium.title: Premium Umrah
umrah_premium.desc: Programs combining hotels located within walking distance of the Holy Harams with elevated amenities for a peaceful, comfortable journey.
umrah_premium.feat_1: 4-star or 5-star hotels within a short walk to the Haram
umrah_premium.feat_2: Direct flights with organized airport reception and transfers
umrah_premium.feat_3: Dedicated field coordination and ongoing pilgrim support

umrah_vip.title: VIP Luxury Umrah
umrah_vip.desc: An extraordinary pilgrimage featuring frontline suites directly overlooking the Holy Kaaba and private luxury chauffeur services.
umrah_vip.feat_1: Direct panoramic views of the Kaaba and premium suites
umrah_vip.feat_2: VIP private luxury vehicle transfers from arrival to departure
umrah_vip.feat_3: 24/7 personalized concierge and dedicated travel assistance

umrah_ramadan.title: Ramadan Umrah
umrah_ramadan.desc: Dedicated programs for the sacred month of Ramadan, covering the early days, mid-month, or the blessed last ten nights.
umrah_ramadan.feat_1: Special packages for the last ten nights and Laylat al-Qadr
umrah_ramadan.feat_2: Close lodging ensuring effortless access for Taraweeh & Tahajjud
umrah_ramadan.feat_3: Tailored meal arrangements for Iftar and Suhoor

hajj_lottery.title: Government Lottery Hajj
hajj_lottery.desc: Official state-supervised pilgrimage programs with organized transportation and accommodation across the Holy Sites under strict regulations.
hajj_lottery.feat_1: Official supervision governed by governmental regulations
hajj_lottery.feat_2: Approved Mina and Arafat camps with field coordination

hajj_tourist.title: Tourist Hajj
hajj_tourist.desc: Pilgrimage itineraries presented by licensed tourism companies with multiple accommodation tiers in Makkah, Madinah, and upgraded holy camps.
hajj_tourist.feat_1: Tiered packages ranging from economy to luxury 5-star hotels
hajj_tourist.feat_2: End-to-end guidance and pilgrim grouping by licensed agencies
hajj_tourist.feat_3: Multiple airline options with coordinated ground logistics

hajj_vip.title: VIP Luxury Hajj

how_it_works.heading: How to Choose Your Program and Connect with an Agency via Miqat
how_it_works.description: Four clear, straightforward steps that eliminate scattered searching and connect you directly with the right licensed agency.
how_it_works.step_1_desc: Browse Hajj and Umrah categories to understand the core differences between accommodation tiers and service packages.
how_it_works.step_2_desc: Review hotel proximities, departure schedules, expected budgets, and itinerary details with complete transparency.
how_it_works.step_3_desc: Submit your specific journey preferences to be routed directly to the sales team of the designated licensed tourism company.
how_it_works.step_4_desc: Conclude your contract, submit travel passports, and process payments directly with the licensed agency under official guidelines.

value.heading: Greater Clarity, Smarter Travel Decisions
value.description: Miqat is intentionally crafted to eliminate the confusion of unstructured travel offers and give you total confidence at every step.
value.item_1_desc: Consistent program presentation makes comparison simple and clear, free from ambiguous claims or omitted details.
value.item_2_desc: Balance distance to the Harams, accommodation standards, and travel costs to find the itinerary that truly fits your needs.
value.item_3_desc: Instead of sifting through fragmented social posts, explore structured, verified options in one dependable interface.
value.item_4_desc: Connect directly with officially licensed tourism companies to complete your arrangements without unknown middlemen.

partnerships.heading: Showcase Your Programs to Serious, High-Intent Travelers
partnerships.description: Miqat empowers licensed tourism companies to showcase their itineraries in a modern digital format and receive qualified contact requests from pilgrims who have already defined their needs.
partnerships.feature_1_desc: A dedicated, professional program presence presenting hotel specifications, proximity, and flight details with pristine clarity.
partnerships.feature_2_desc: Attract pilgrims actively seeking Hajj and Umrah packages who have already defined their travel season and budget.
partnerships.feature_3_title: Direct Handoff to Your Sales Team
partnerships.feature_3_desc: Inquiries with a clear summary of traveler requirements are routed directly to your team via a dedicated link or WhatsApp.
partnerships.feature_4_desc: Your company retains full authority over pricing, document collection, contractual agreements, and financial transactions.
partnerships.req_1: A valid, officially recognized tourism license issued by competent government authorities.
partnerships.req_2: Complete truthfulness and accuracy of all uploaded data including hotel tiers, distances, and genuine prices.
partnerships.req_3: Commitment to respond to forwarded booking inquiries within 24 hours to ensure an exceptional pilgrim experience.

transparency.heading: Miqat's Role in Your Journey
transparency.text: Miqat is an independent digital platform built to simplify exploring and comparing Hajj and Umrah programs, facilitating structured communication between travelers and licensed tourism agencies. Miqat's scope is strictly focused on discovery, comparison, and qualified communication handoff. All contractual commitments, visa issuances, financial payments, and operational pilgrimage services are carried out directly by the chosen licensed tourism company under established regulatory standards.

final_cta.heading: Clearer Choices, Seamless Connection with Licensed Operators
final_cta.desc: Whether you are a pilgrim seeking the ideal journey or a licensed agency expanding your reach, Miqat is your trusted gateway.

footer.brand_desc: A premier digital platform for exploring and comparing Hajj & Umrah programs, connecting pilgrims directly with licensed tourism companies.

partner_hub.hero_title: Welcome to the Miqat Partner Network
partner_hub.hero_subtitle: We are honored to welcome your travel agency to Egypt's leading digital marketplace for Umrah and Hajj. Your application is currently undergoing administrative review and official document verification. Below is an overview of our partnership model, mutual commitments, and commercial benefits.
partner_hub.about_title: Egypt's Unified Digital Marketplace for Umrah & Hajj
partner_hub.about_desc: Miqat is a dedicated national digital platform engineered to modernize and streamline the pilgrimage travel market. By providing a transparent, trustworthy ecosystem connecting Egyptian pilgrims directly with licensed Category A tourism agencies, Miqat eliminates untrusted intermediaries and informal brokers.
partner_hub.about_pillar_1_desc: Clear display of verified program details (exact hotel names, audited walking distances in meters, certified flight itineraries) without ambiguity.
partner_hub.about_pillar_2_desc: Providing a direct, cost-effective digital marketing channel for licensed operators to reach qualified pilgrims and lower customer acquisition costs.
partner_hub.about_pillar_3_desc: Empowering pilgrims to compare objectively and make informed spiritual decisions matching their budget, health, and comfort requirements.
partner_hub.why_title: Marketing & Operational Solutions Maximizing Your ROI
partner_hub.why_subtitle: Miqat was built to eliminate traditional marketing inefficiencies, high digital ad spend, and vacant seats before trip departure dates.
partner_hub.why_card_1_desc: Say goodbye to wasted advertising budgets. Receive qualified booking inquiries from pilgrims who have already filtered by dates, budget, and hotel tier.
partner_hub.why_card_2_desc: Newly onboarded agencies publish packages at zero upfront cost to test platform efficiency, sales volume, and customer quality risk-free.
partner_hub.why_card_3_title: Instant Lead Dispatch via WhatsApp & Portal
partner_hub.why_card_3_desc: The moment a pilgrim submits an inquiry, lead details and travel preferences are immediately routed to your sales team via WhatsApp and your portal desk.
partner_hub.why_card_4_desc: The official accreditation badge reinforces pilgrim trust and boosts booking conversion rates by over 40% compared to generic listings.
partner_hub.why_card_5_desc: Fill remaining empty seats before trip registration deadlines through targeted notifications sent to pilgrims looking for immediate departure.
partner_hub.why_card_6_desc: Miqat never interferes with your package pricing, profit margins, or internal policies; you maintain full control over your trips and collections.
partner_hub.contracts_title: Balanced Partnership, Protected Rights & Mutual Commitment
partner_hub.contracts_desc: Partnership with Miqat is built on clear commitments and balanced obligations, safeguarding the interests of the travel agency, the platform, and the pilgrim.
partner_hub.comp_ob_1: Maintain a valid, active Category A license issued by the Egyptian Ministry of Tourism.
partner_hub.comp_ob_2: Provide accurate package information (hotel names, audited distances to Haram, inclusions).
partner_hub.comp_ob_3: Promptly respond to pilgrim booking inquiries routed through the platform within 4 business hours.
partner_hub.comp_ob_4: Faithfully execute the agreed itinerary and deliver all promised travel services.
partner_hub.comp_ob_5: Keep booking statuses updated on the platform to maintain operational data integrity.
partner_hub.miqat_ob_1: Dispatch verified, pre-qualified inquiries with authentic Egyptian phone numbers and clear requirements.
partner_hub.miqat_ob_2: Zero interference with your pricing structure, margins, or internal business operations.
partner_hub.miqat_ob_3: Complete confidentiality regarding your operational records, pricing policies, and customer lists.
partner_hub.miqat_ob_4: Maintain 99.9% platform availability and provide a reliable management dashboard.
partner_hub.miqat_ob_5: Designating a dedicated onboarding advisor available via phone and WhatsApp for ongoing agency support.
partner_hub.workflow_title: From Pilgrim Search to Booking Confirmation & Departure
partner_hub.workflow_step_1_desc: Pilgrims explore verified agency programs, filtering by travel dates, budget, and distance to the Holy Mosque.
partner_hub.workflow_step_2_desc: Miqat's automated verification engine validates the pilgrim's phone number and confirms inquiry criteria.
partner_hub.workflow_step_3_desc: Lead details are dispatched instantly to your sales desk via automated WhatsApp alerts and portal notifications.
partner_hub.workflow_step_4_desc: Your reservation team contacts the pilgrim directly, collects passport copies, and finalizes payment arrangements.
partner_hub.workflow_step_5_desc: Booking status is updated to confirmed on the platform, and support continues through departure and return.
